_help: Watt: c_akarin's own body on every row (its ray ring, flickering through its three ray textures as PM64's drawings flicker, sized and moved per drawing; its face disc), and only the features from the PM64 sprite's pixels per tick (read from the player's ROM at runtime): eyes, cheeks, pacifier (the model's eyes and pacifier hidden), and the bolts as small quads.
